State-continuity 75/100 (IND) — long-entrenched state (pre-democracy governance proxy). Religious tolerance 50/100 (modeled from the era's state-religion pattern for this region). Scored on 2 of 5 factors with recorded data (safety, governance); health, economy, religious tolerance had no record for this region and year and were left out of the score.
